name: Grocery List Merger
pitch: Merges the shopping lists of everyone in a household into one list sorted by store aisle.
mechanism: Each person adds items in a shared chat, and a small model normalizes names such as milk and 2% milk. Items are grouped by an aisle map the household edits once per store, duplicates are merged and quantities are added up.

name: Commit Message Linter
pitch: Rejects commit messages that do not say why a change was made.
mechanism: A git hook sends the commit message and a short diff summary to a yes/no classifier that asks whether the message explains the reason for the change. Below a threshold the commit is blocked with a one-line hint, and a flag skips the check.

name: Meeting Action Item Extractor
pitch: Pulls action items, owners and due dates out of a meeting transcript.
mechanism: The transcript is split into speaker turns and each turn is classified as an action item or not. Action items get an owner picked from the attendee list and a due date parsed by code, then they are posted to the team channel as a checklist.

name: Productivity Copilot
pitch: An AI assistant that makes your workday easier.
mechanism: It uses a large language model to help with everyday work. You can ask it anything and it answers.

name: Bug Report Deduplicator
pitch: Finds new bug reports that describe an issue already in the tracker.
mechanism: Each new report is compared with its ten most similar open issues by text similarity, and a model judges each pair as the same bug or not. Matches above a threshold are linked and the reporter is pointed to the existing issue.

name: Lecture Slide Quiz Maker
pitch: Turns a lecture's slides into a ten-question practice quiz.
mechanism: Slide text is extracted page by page and a model writes one multiple-choice question per key concept. A second pass checks that each answer is supported by the slide it came from, and students get the quiz as a shareable link.

name: Rental Listing Scam Checker
pitch: Flags rental listings whose text matches common scam patterns.
mechanism: The listing text, price and contact details are checked against a list of scam signals: a deposit before any viewing, a price far below the local median, payment outside the platform. Each signal is one yes/no question to a classifier, and code computes the local median from public listings.

name: Recipe Swap Suggester
pitch: Suggests ingredient substitutions using only what is already in your fridge.
mechanism: You list the ingredients you have, and for a chosen recipe the app finds the missing ones. Substitutes from your list are ranked with a small table of what each ingredient does in cooking (fat, acid, binder), and a model explains each swap in one sentence.

name: Voice Memo Sorter
pitch: Files voice memos into project folders by what they talk about.
mechanism: Memos are transcribed on the phone, then each transcript is matched against the user's folder names and earlier memos. The best folder is used when the match is confident; otherwise the memo waits in an inbox.

name: Startup Idea Generator
pitch: Generates unlimited startup ideas with AI.
mechanism: A language model is prompted to brainstorm startup ideas. The user can save the ones they like.

name: Parking Sign Interpreter
pitch: Reads a photo of stacked parking signs and says whether you can park there right now.
mechanism: A vision model transcribes each sign and code turns the rules into time ranges for the current day. The app answers yes or no and shows the rule that decided it; unclear signs return check manually.

name: Pull Request Risk Labeler
pitch: Labels each pull request low, medium or high risk so reviewers know where to look first.
mechanism: The diff is summarized per file, and a classifier scores each file on whether it touches authentication, data deletion or payments. The highest file score becomes the pull request label, and the risky files are listed in a comment.

name: Bedtime Story Narrator
pitch: Writes and reads aloud a calm bedtime story that features your child's own toys.
mechanism: Parents enter the toy names and a theme, a model writes a five-minute story, and a text-to-speech voice reads it slowly. Stories are saved so they can be played again.

name: Wellness Companion
pitch: A friendly AI that supports your mental wellness every day.
mechanism: The app chats with you about how you feel and offers encouragement. It is powered by AI.

name: Freelance Contract Clause Highlighter
pitch: Highlights clauses in a freelance contract that shift risk onto the freelancer.
mechanism: The contract is split into clauses and each clause gets yes/no questions such as unlimited revisions, payment only after client approval, or transfer of rights before payment. Flagged clauses are highlighted with the matching question as the reason.

name: Board Game Rules Referee
pitch: Answers rules questions during a board game by pointing to the exact rulebook paragraph.
mechanism: The rulebook is split into numbered paragraphs. For each question a retriever shortlists paragraphs and a model picks the one that answers it, and the app shows that paragraph itself rather than a paraphrase.

name: Plant Watering Reminder from Photos
pitch: Tells you which houseplant needs water by looking at a weekly photo of each plant.
mechanism: Each week you photograph every plant, and a vision model rates leaf droop and soil color against the previous photo. When the rating drops, the app sends a watering reminder for that plant.

name: Grant Call Matcher
pitch: Collects grant calls from public listings and alerts you to the ones that fit your project.
mechanism: Listings are collected daily, deadlines are parsed by code, and each call is judged against a short project profile on eligibility and topic fit. Calls above a threshold go into a weekly email sorted by deadline.

name: AI Content Booster
pitch: Boost your content with the power of AI.
mechanism: It improves any text you give it using a language model. It works with blogs, posts and more.

name: Alt Text Auditor
pitch: Finds images on a website whose alt text does not describe the image.
mechanism: A crawler collects each image with its alt text, and a vision model writes a short caption for the image. A classifier judges whether the alt text and the caption describe the same thing, and the report lists failing images by page.

name: Inbox Newsletter Digest
pitch: Bundles a week of newsletters into one digest email with a summary of each newsletter.
mechanism: A mail filter moves newsletters into a folder. Once a week each newsletter is summarized in three bullet points and the summaries are sent together as a single email, with links to the originals.

name: Language Exchange Matcher
pitch: Pairs language learners whose native and target languages complement each other and whose free hours overlap.
mechanism: Profiles list native language, target language, level and free hours. Code finds complementary pairs with overlapping hours, and a model ranks them by shared interests found in a short bio.

name: Code Review Tone Fixer
pitch: Rewrites harsh code review comments into direct but polite ones before they are posted.
mechanism: A browser extension catches the comment before it is posted and a classifier scores it for harshness. Only comments above a threshold are rewritten by a model, and the author sees both versions and picks one.

name: Second-hand Price Estimator
pitch: Estimates the resale value of a second-hand item from a photo of it and its label.
mechanism: A vision model identifies the brand and the item type, and code looks up recent sale prices of similar listings. The app shows a price range and how many sales it was based on.

name: Smart Study Buddy
pitch: Your personal AI study partner.
mechanism: It helps you study better with AI. Ask questions and get answers anytime.

name: Flaky Test Detector
pitch: Finds tests that both fail and pass on the same code so they can be quarantined.
mechanism: Test results are stored per test and per commit, and code flags tests whose outcome changed without a code change. A model groups the failure messages by likely cause, so one fix covers several tests.

name: Call Transcript Task Finder
pitch: Finds the to-dos in a recorded call, who owns each one and when it is due.
mechanism: The call recording is transcribed and split by speaker, and each turn is classified as a task or not. Tasks get an owner chosen from the participants and a due date parsed from the text, then the list is sent to the team as a checklist.

name: Noise Complaint Builder
pitch: Turns a short audio clip into a structured noise complaint with time, level and type.
mechanism: The phone records ten seconds of audio, code measures the decibel level, and a classifier labels the noise type: construction, music or traffic. The app fills in the city complaint form fields and the user submits it.

name: API Breaking Change Watcher
pitch: Tells you when an API your code depends on announces a breaking change.
mechanism: The tool reads your dependency files, follows each provider's changelog feed and asks a classifier whether each new entry is a breaking change for an endpoint you use. Matches open an issue in your repository.

name: Weekly Newsletter Roll-up
pitch: Collects the newsletters you received this week and sends you one email that summarizes each of them.
mechanism: Newsletters are filtered into a separate folder as they arrive. Every week each one is summarized in a few bullet points, and all the summaries go out together in one email with links back to the originals.

name: Life Coach Bot
pitch: An AI life coach that helps you reach your goals.
mechanism: Tell it your goals and it motivates you with personalized AI advice. It learns from your conversations.

name: Dataset License Checker
pitch: Checks whether a dataset's license allows the use you plan before you download it.
mechanism: The tool fetches the dataset card and license text and asks one yes/no question per planned use: commercial use, redistribution, model training. The answer lists each use as allowed, not allowed or unclear, with the license sentence behind it.

name: Pantry Ingredient Substitutes
pitch: When a recipe calls for something you lack, proposes a substitute from the food you already have at home.
mechanism: You keep a list of what is in your pantry and fridge. For the recipe you pick, missing ingredients are matched to substitutes from that list using a table of what each ingredient does in cooking (fat, acid, binder), and a short explanation is shown for each swap.

name: Commute Playlist Builder
pitch: Builds a playlist for your commute that fits the weather and how long the trip will take.
mechanism: The app reads the forecast and the expected trip time, and a small classifier picks a mood label. It fills the length of the trip with songs from your library tagged with that mood.

name: Volunteer Shift Filler
pitch: Finds volunteers for open shifts by matching each shift's needs to people's stated skills and free time.
mechanism: Shifts list a time and the skills needed, and volunteers describe their availability and skills in free text. A model judges each volunteer and shift pair for fit, code removes people who are already booked, and the coordinator gets a ranked short list per shift.

name: Code Change Risk Triage
pitch: Sorts incoming pull requests by how risky they are so the riskiest get reviewed first.
mechanism: Every changed file in a pull request is scored on whether it touches authentication, deletes data or handles payments. The pull request takes the highest file score as its risk label, and a comment lists the files that drove it.

name: Museum Audio Guide Maker
pitch: Creates a spoken audio guide for a small museum from its existing exhibit labels.
mechanism: Staff upload photos of the labels, the text is extracted, and a model rewrites each label as a one-minute spoken script. Text-to-speech produces the audio, and visitors scan a code next to each exhibit to play it.

name: Habit Streak Explainer
pitch: Explains why your habit streaks break by finding what the missed days have in common.
mechanism: The app logs habit check-ins with context such as sleep hours, calendar load and weather. Code compares missed days with completed days, and a model writes the strongest pattern as one sentence.

name: Houseplant Thirst Detector
pitch: Compares weekly photos of each houseplant and reminds you to water the ones that look dry.
mechanism: You take a photo of every plant once a week. A vision model scores how much the leaves droop and how dry the soil looks compared with last week, and a drop in the score triggers a watering reminder for that plant.

name: First Issue Matchmaker
pitch: Suggests beginner-friendly open source issues that match the languages and topics a new contributor knows.
mechanism: The tool reads issues labeled for newcomers across many repositories, and a classifier scores each issue on how much setup it needs and whether its description is complete. Issues are matched to a contributor's profile and sent as a weekly short list.
